definitions.explanation: shocked and unable to react, usually in a negative way

examples.japanese: その{知|し}らせに{愕然|がくぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was dumbfounded by the news.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}を{見|み}て{愕然|がくぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was stunned when I saw the results.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}のミスに{愕然|がくぜん}として{言葉|ことば}が{出|で}なかった。
examples.english: I was so shocked by my own mistake that I couldn't speak.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with とする: {愕然|がくぜん}とする
{愕然|がくぜん} implies shock at something unexpected and usually negative. It suggests being left speechless.

RELATED WORDS:
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}とする - to be dazed, stunned
- {唖然|あぜん}とする - to be struck dumb
- {驚愕|きょうがく}する - to be astonished

ALL THESE "～{然|ぜん}" WORDS:
These tari-adjectives describe states of emotional shock, each with slightly different nuances.
